### Fixed
- **The kagent controller GRPCRoutes match `grpc.health.v1.Health`** (giantswarm/agent-platform#844). The kagent CLI pointed at the edge (`--api-url https://agentgateway.<domain>:8443`) checks reachability with the gRPC health service, which the controller registers; without a match the call fell into the MCP catch-all (`mcp: client must accept both application/json and text/event-stream`). Both routes, the data-plane `kagent-controller` and the edge `kagent-controller-public`, carry one service-only match for it next to `kagent.controllerRoute.grpc.services`; `make verify-kagent-route` asserts it on both.
